Wat is het verschil tussen Saviynt en Ke: What is the difference between Saviynt and Keycloak?
Saviynt bepaalt wie wat mag en waarom: r: Saviynt determines who may do what and why: roles, requests, reviews. Keycloak carries it out at every sign-in: sessions and tokens. Roles change in Saviynt, never in Keycloak.
Waarom Keycloak tussen Entra ID en de sy: Why put Keycloak between Entra ID and the systems?
Zodat de systemen niet aan Entra ID vast: So that the systems are not tied to Entra ID. If Entra ID is replaced, only the connection behind Keycloak changes.
De rechten die iemand krijgt door zijn f: The rights someone gets through their job, without a request. Anything beyond that is an additional right, with a request, an approver and a review.
Verdwijnt het werk van functioneel behee: Does the work of application management disappear?
Het handwerk wel: accounts aanmaken en r: The manual work does: creating accounts and granting rights per ticket. What remains is substantive: mapping roles, assigning cases, helping to draft the policy and assessing exceptions.
Wie beslist wie zegelbevoegd is?: Who decides who is authorised to seal?
De gemeentesecretaris, via een aanvraag: The municipal secretary, via a request in Saviynt. The sealing service only looks at the role in the token.
Hoe snel is iemand die vertrekt eruit?: How quickly is a leaver locked out?
Op het geplande moment gaat het account: At the scheduled time, the account is disabled and all sessions end. Tokens are valid for five minutes, so within five minutes nothing works any more.
Heeft de Office Assistent eigen rechten?: Does the Office Assistant have rights of its own?
Nee. De assistent handelt altijd namens: No. The assistant always acts on behalf of the employee, with an exchanged token. What the employee may not do, the assistant cannot do either.
Een beheerder ziet de metadata. De inhou: An administrator sees the metadata. The content only with a recorded reason and a notification to security.
Neemt IAM de rechten van het zaaksysteem: Does IAM take over the case management system's permissions?
Nee. Het zaaksysteem blijft leidend voor: No. The case management system remains authoritative for who handles which case. The decision point queries that relationship.
Moeten we meteen naar ABAC?: Do we have to move to ABAC straight away?
Nee. Eerst gaan de regels van nu één op: No. First, today's rules move one-to-one to the decision point. Then attributes and relationships are added, per type of document.
Nee. Inwoners melden zich aan met DigiD: No. Residents sign in with DigiD in a separate Keycloak realm, and get only their own documents and public documents.
